messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — Cinder Labs QBR prep. Meeting Wed 4/14 10am PT. Need final cost slide + 90d token burn by product + embedding route heatmap + top 5 prompt fingerprints causing bursts. Assigning owners. I'll capture action items here.
jess_onboard: I can pull onboarding usage metrics and the day-0 spikes (customer ramp). Will add notes on embed-heavy flows.
kevin_fin: I'll do the 90d token burn + forecast out to renewal (monthly burn curve). Need last commit discounts + any committed units.
aj_prod: @jess_onboard can you also confirm any A/B test toggles the client has? That drove a 3x spike last month.
samir_sre: I'll export the agent routes and add latency vs cost per route. Also checking KV cache miss rates that could inflate token counts.
cost-bot: Alert summary for Cinder Labs: 3 alerts in last 30d — embed-heavy /chat/stream route spikes (avg +220%), unbounded batch config detected on prod-2, and token quota nearing 85% of monthly cap.
maria_cs: Perfect. Two asks: (1) a one-slide action plan with mitigations (rate limits, caching, smaller models on background jobs) (2) a short note for CS about expected savings if we implement the mitigations (ballpark %). Kevin, can you cost those?
kevin_fin: Yes. Quick model: current monthly token spend ~$68k. If we add prefix caching + down-quantize background workers, estimate 28–35% savings. Will put numbers in a spreadsheet.
jess_onboard: Drafted the embed heatmap here: https://redwood.internal/qbr/cinder-labs/embed-heatmap (will share fig). Also found 2 routes with repeated duplicate inputs — probable client-side retry bug.
aj_prod: For the top-5 prompt fingerprints: i'm attaching sample normalized prompts. Short list: 'summarize + context', 'QA-stream', 'embed-search-ctx' — ps: we should recommend batching or shorter context for 'summarize' flows.
samir_sre: Quick snippet I ran to find repeated payloads:
```sql
SELECT input_hash, count(*) as hits
FROM logs
WHERE customer_id='cinder' AND ts > now()-interval '30 days'
GROUP BY input_hash
ORDER BY hits DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Gives duplicates we can dedupe at gateway.
elaine_cs: I'll own the enablement slide and customer messaging. Can someone drop the 'what we'll change' bullets by EOD Monday? I'll rehearse before QBR.
maria_cs: Thanks all. Action items summary:
- Kevin: cost model + savings estimates (spreadsheet link)
- Jess: onboarding spike timeline + duplicate inputs
- Samir: route cost breakdown + dedupe runbook
- Aj: prompt fingerprints + recommended mitigations
- Elaine: enablement messaging
I'll assemble the slide deck and send draft tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
